description: ILC MVP protocol surfaces for claims, refutes, tasks, outcomes, and epoch summaries.

fields.parent_ids: array<string> - parents in the epistemic graph
fields.net_stake: number - total stake currently attached to this claim

refute.description: Refutation attempt tying to a target claim.

task.description: Logical unit of work submitted to the protocol.

fields.payload_ref: string - reference into content / graph / storage
fields.epoch: integer - epoch in which the task is admitted
fields.meta: object - free-form metadata (domain, hardware tier, etc.)

task_outcome.description: Economic outcome of a task for telemetry and learning.

fields.stake_spent: number - ECU-equivalent stake burned or locked
fields.reward_paid: number - ILC paid for this task

epoch_summary.description: Aggregate economic stats for an epoch.

fields.meta: object - optional, may include congestion, hardware stats, etc.
